id.description: Stable slug. Also the pack directory name.

origin.description: [lon, lat] anchor for the engine's local metric projection.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or 'proprietary'. Drives attribution UI and the Rule 3 boundary check.

attribution.description: Strings the engine must display. May be empty only for CC0-1.0.

demand.description: Municipality-level demand points (gravity or matrix model). Required.

obstacles.description: Building footprints used for gameplay collision.

barriers.description: Rivers, rail corridors and other linear barriers.

subward.description: Town-level (chome) population, one file per wards group; may have a .gz sibling (see `compressed`).

buildingPopulation.description: MODELED per-building residents for a pilot area.

jobs.description: Workers per town from the Economic Census.

jobsBuildings.description: MODELED per-building workers for a pilot area.

od.description: Measured municipality-to-municipality commuter flows (census). Optional; the engine uses it for destination choice.

specialDemand.description: Point demand outside the commute model (schools, hospitals, ...).

buildingTiles.description: PMTiles of building footprints for rendering.

buildingTilesRegional.description: Additional building PMTiles for surrounding regions.

roadTiles.description: PMTiles of roads and pedestrian ways.

files.description: Relative paths (a value may be a list of paths). An absent key means that layer is not present. Every key a pack uses must be declared here - validate-pack enforces it.

quality.description: Self-assessment against the registry data-quality rubric (docs/data-quality.md).

compressed.description: Files that also exist as a gzip sibling: { 'x.json': { file, encoding:'gzip', bytes, gzBytes } }.

then.description: Any pack that is not CC0 must carry at least one attribution string.
